title: The Vault's Stone
journal: The second seal-stone lies in the lowest hall of the Vaults of Gemin, which is under water. The dead walk the vaults and a wraith guards the last hall, and Unbound may be searching there; all of them attack whoever they see. I need to go down and take it. I can fight through, slip past them or turn the dead with Restoration.
objectives: Take the seal-stone from the drowned lowest hall of Gemin. (marker: Seal-Stone of the Kings, Gemin)
Read the Tablet of the Kings beside the stone. (marker: Tablet of the Kings)

plan.going: The Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel, sits at the Root under Teku-Sul, where the roots of every Hist meet; used there it heals every sick tree. The Kings' Gate shuts it in and opens only with three seal-stones. I am hunting the three seal-stones for the Toh-Reel-Ka; this one is in Gemin's drowned lowest hall
plan.next: go down through the vaults to the lowest hall and take the stone; read the tablet beside it
plan.ways: fight the Unbound, the dead and the wraith; slip past them (Sneak); turn the dead and the wraith (Restoration); I must swim the last hall, or carry waterbreathing

answers: I am collecting three seal-stones for the Kings Gate at Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth. I already have the first from Blackrose. The second is in the drowned lowest hall of the Vaults of Gemin. Dead walk the vaults, a wraith guards the last hall, and Unbound may be there too.
Go down through the vaults to the lowest hall, take the Seal-Stone of the Kings, and read the Tablet of the Kings beside it.
Fight through, slip past them, or turn the dead with Restoration.
I do not know what the Root and Eye truly are, or whether Ennodius Vanin is the real master. I could learn more from the tablet and by talking to people.

title: The Vault's Stone
journal: I took the second seal-stone from the drowned hall of Gemin. The tablet beside it says that the Eye, lifted, parts every tree from every other, and used where it sits, it strengthens them. I already carry the thief's stone from Blackrose. One is left in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and it is still marked.

answers: I took the second seal-stone from Gemin. The tablet says the Eye, if lifted, parts every tree from every other, and if used where it sits it strengthens them. I now hold two stones; the third is at Vorannuhl.
Go to the deepest hall of Vorannuhl (marked) for the last stone, then take all three to the Kings Gate at Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth.
Fight, sneak or turn the dead there; I could also check Fort Chalkmoth cellar or look into Vanin first.
I still do not know what the Root and Eye truly are, what the trees are, or whether Vanin is the real master. I could learn more by reading further tablets and asking people.
